The plan a recipe executes as, before any capability check (A-14)

Source: R/plan_exec_v2.R
dot-recipe_select_plan.Rd

A recipe built only from 2.10.1 constructors (and without parent_id) executes as its unchanged v1 plan; the server's legacy adapters keep its results. When the v1 compiler refuses one of the shapes 2.10.3 newly permits (.v1_newly_permitted()), or the recipe uses a language-2 construct or parent_id, the plan is its v2 rendering. A recipe that has neither a v1 plan nor a native rendering is refused, naming both the construct the native compiler cannot render and what prevents the v1 plan.

Usage

.recipe_select_plan(recipe)

Arguments

recipe

An omop_recipe.

Value

A v1 omop_plan or an omop_plan_v2; attribute "v1_refusal" on a v2 plan selected for a newly permitted shape.
